target.role: fresh whole-journey contender discovery after Run 117's canonical dissolution-to-re-entry addition, spanning a 2026 current-release collaboration, adjacent batida and East African club forms, and overlooked Chicago footwork catalogue
target.purpose: Test whether withdrawal, perceptual tempo change, polyrhythmic glide, internal downshift or compressed breakdown creates a necessary external consequence at transition, local-run and long-form scale rather than merely demonstrating structural freedom.
target.position: Whole 28-track journey; preserve Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer. Treat every placement as provisional and candidate-specific; do not reopen untriggered PARKED identities.

explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 54 named tracks, releases and current-source entries across September 7–10, 2026 review and festival coverage, 2026 DJ Plead/PPP and Flying Lotus releases, Príncipe/Hakuna Kulala adjacent club catalogues, and overlooked 2018 Chicago footwork; attributed criticism and release metadata only; no audio audition.
sourceWindows: CURRENT: September 7–10, 2026 Pitchfork review coverage, The Guardian's September 4 track survey and End of the Road reporting were inspected. PPP — Wisco and Flying Lotus — Antelope Onigiri survive as exact 2026 leads; previously decided or unresolved Nueen, PISS, Silvan Strauss and Bitchin Bajas entries were excluded. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/tracks/ppp-piezo-dj-plead-dj-python-wisco and https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/flying-lotus-big-mama

ADJACENT / EMERGING CATALOGUE: Nídia's S/T and Slikback's Lasakaneku / Tomo were inspected for shape-changing polyrhythm, tempo perception and production-world changes without assuming sequence fit. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/nidia-st-ep and https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/slikback-lasakaneku-tomo

OVERLOOKED RHYTHMIC CATALOGUE: RP Boo's I'll Tell You What! was inspected for drum-machine withdrawal, abrupt downshift and form changes that preserve footwork only by implication. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/rp-boo-ill-tell-you-what

FRESHNESS CHECK: current canonical, rejected, revisit, target-local discovery and 230-track utility state contain no prior artist-title decision for the nine requested identities; current-release overlap is limited to the exact new PPP and Flying Lotus leads.
exclusions: Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, existing utility discoveries and unresolved prior leads without materially new identity evidence were excluded.

Runs 112–117 selected artist and label ecosystems were not retried; the scan moved away from KAVARI/Overmono/Sote, Skrillex/Daphni/Sam Prekop, Helena Hauff/Mykki Blanco, Demdike Stare/Autechre/Laurel Halo, Lee Gamble/Ziúr/Errorsmith/Rey Sapienz and aya/Speaker Music/Nazar/Nkisi/TSVI/Loraine James/Nueen.

Current-source ambient, jazz and festival entries without enough candidate-level rhythmic or structural evidence were inspected but did not displace stronger leads; catalogue age was not treated as a defect.
No Spotify connector, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
